turns.question: How would you debug a Spark job that fails after four hours?
turns.answer: I start with the stage that fails, because the symptom is usually an out-of-memory error on a shuffle. In one case 80 percent of rows shared a single key, so I salted the hot key and the job finished in 40 minutes. This is Jordan Rivera, you can reach me at jordan@example.com.

turns.question: How do you decide whether an experiment result is trustworthy?
turns.answer: I check the experiment design first: was assignment random and was the sample ratio what we planned? Then I look at statistics, because a result with a wide interval is not a result. Call me on 512-555-0142 if you want the notebook.

turns.question: Describe a streaming system you built.
turns.answer: We used Kafka with one topic per event type and wrote to a single table. The hard part was distributed systems behaviour under retries, therefore every consumer had to be idempotent.
